references.text: David cries out to God for mercy in his distress, which mirrors the cry for mercy in Matthew 20:31.
Two blind men cry out to Jesus, 'Son of David, have mercy on us!' which is a direct parallel to the event in Matthew 20:31.
A blind man cries out to Jesus, 'Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!' which resembles the cry for mercy in Matthew 20:31.
